zh-CN.name: 空间分析
zh-CN.description: 对道路、站点与区域数据进行缓冲、最近邻和空间连接分析，输出可复核的结果。
features: 按米制距离划定缓冲区，确定设施覆盖范围
查找最近设施，计算距离并识别未匹配对象
关联点与区域，输出地图数据、数量统计及异常记录

en-US.name: Spatial Analysis
en-US.description: Runs buffer, nearest-neighbor and spatial-join analysis on roads, stations and regions, producing auditable results.
features: Builds metric-distance buffers for facility coverage
Finds nearest facilities, measures distances and identifies unmatched features
Associates points with regions and outputs map data, counts and exceptions
